search_text: published ZDI-16-617 ZDI-CAN-3748 Dell SonicWALL Universal Management Suite ImagePreviewServlet SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2016-12-02 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['Dell'] ['SonicWALL Universal Management Suite'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Dell SonicWALL Universal Management Suite.
